verdict.rationale: Drata publishes its API v2 reference under an /openapi/reference/v2/ path covering many resource tags (Controls, Policies, Personnel, Devices, Risks and more), which suggests the docs are generated from an OpenAPI spec. However, no evidence shows a downloadable spec file, and probes of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicitly documented download link or URL for the OpenAPI/JSON/YAML spec, and hands-on confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.
